incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert triggered: routing-heartbeat-miss (eu-west-1) — synthetic heartbeat failed 3x in 60s
pagerduty: PagerDuty: incident routed to on-call (oliver). Escalation policy: infra-rotations.
oliver: acked. looking
oliver: checking the canary dashboard and router metrics now, probably a noisy probe
sara: i see a short spike in heartbeat misses from the regional probe pool, ~30s window
oliver: running quick check, `kubectl -n routing logs deploy/routing-proxy --since=2m | grep heartbeat`
infra-runbot: log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T12:14:02Z routing-proxy[pid=1124]: heartbeat check failed to /healthz (timeout)
2026-03-15T12:14:03Z routing-proxy[pid=1124]: retry ok
2026-03-15T12:14:04Z routing-proxy[pid=1124]: heartbeat ok
```
oliver: looks transient, retries succeeded within 2s mostly. doesn't look like client-facing errors right now
mike: any customer impact? metrics?
sara: SLOs: no errors spiked on front door, 5xx rate steady. latency had a tiny tail bump ~200ms for a handful of requests during the window
oliver: i'll silence the alert channel for 10m while we watch, to avoid churn. silencing now: `incident-bot silence routing-heartbeat-miss 10m --reason "transient probe retries"`
incident-bot: Silence created (10m) by oliver — will auto-expire
oliver: leaving extra breadcrumbs in ops doc: potential noisy probe instance in eu-west-1, tagging for follow-up with infra team
sara: flagging for postmortem? i think just a note unless it repeats
mike: agree—if it flaps >3x in next hour we escalate to infra and open dedicated ticket
oliver: noted. i'll handoff to night on-call in case it reappears: @mike you're next, briefed.
mike: got it. monitoring the silence window and will re-open if new alerts come in
incident-bot: Alert auto-resolved: routing-heartbeat-miss (eu-west-1) — condition cleared
pagerduty: PagerDuty: incident closed (no escalation).
oliver: closing thread — short-lived noise, no customer-facing impact. will create follow-up ticket to rotate that probe instance if we see recurrence :thumbsup:
